event: Daily Intelligence Briefing
title: Daily Market Briefing
text:
BOTTOM LINE — Semis ripped, cyclicals bid, defensives bled.
SOXX +3.91% with SOXX/SMH inflows at the 100th percentile drove a tech-cyclical tape as the Oct 27 consumer confidence print (91.7 vs 81 fc) crushed estimates, with Oct 23 manufacturing PMI 56.0 vs 55.5 fc signaling growth still intact. Megacap breadth divergence and SPY PCR 1.54 tell you the strength is concentrated, not shared, and 100% December hike odds in the market-implied curve means liquidity is chasing earnings growth, not the rate path.
INDICES — VIX 17.5, above its 16.7 20-day MA but benign in the 13.5–31.1 range.
SOXX +3.91%, QQQ +1.27%, IWM +1.15%, SPY +0.56%, DIA +0.06%. Large > small by 0.12pp — cap stratification is gone; sector selection is the game. Gold +1.21% even as the dollar added 0.38% — an unusual pairing that flags inflation-hedge demand.
VOLUME & BREADTH — Volume is average at 0.83x with sector SPDRs at 0.84x, so today's move is a repricing, not a confirmation.
RSP 1.1x and IJR 1.0x are gaining attention; GLD 0.7x, SLV 0.7x, IJH 0.7x ignored — rotation into equal-weight/small-cap stocks, defensiveness sold. Within sectors XLB 1.0x gained while XLK 0.9x and XLU 0.5x faded; SPY and QQQ vol_ratio not flagged above average, so the tech pop came without volume sponsorship. Breadth confirms: 60% above 50-DMA, 58% above 200-DMA, 245/256 adv-dec, up/down vol 1.40, 25/12 new 60-day highs/lows, and the tape is NOT narrow — participation is real.
SECTORS & ROTATION — XLK Technology +1.70%, XLY Discretionary +1.04%, XLB Materials +0.78%, XLU Utilities +0.71%, XLI Industrials +0.57%, XLV Healthcare -0.06%, XLF Financials -0.25%, XLC Comms -0.26%, XLRE Real Estate -0.84%, XLP Staples -0.92%, XLE Energy -2.05%.
Industries: WGMI +7.94% and XME +4.68% led; XOP -2.37% and USO -1.41% lagged. Flows: XLP +$413mm (90p) and XLK +$392mm (79p) led 5-day inflows; XLU -$883mm (0p) and XLF -$806mm (15p) bled hardest. Money-in camp: crypto mining, metals/miners, AI semis — SOXX/SMH both at 100th percentile. Money-out camp: energy and utilities. Rotation-state: AI hardware leading.
POSITIONING — SPY PCR 1.54 screams protection buying even as index IV sits at 13.0%; QQQ PCR 0.39 shows complacency on tech. QQQ ATM_IV 21.4% and skew +10.4% mean downside puts are rich. VIXEQ 41.7 vs VIX 17.5 is a wide gap — high dispersion, low implied correlation, a stock-pickers' tape.
CROSS-ASSET — Gold +1.21% up alongside UUP +0.38% is the odd pairing: both as inflation hedges while crude USO -1.41% and XLE -2.05% fade. The API crude build -203.1 vs +52.2 fc reinforces the oil, not a demand story. Next FOMC Oct 28 with 100% hike odds per CME FedWatch — the entire 25bp is priced; surprises only come via the statement.
SIGNALS & WATCH — Fear & Greed 55.1, Neutral.
BA -10.69% on 6.2x volume with a bearish technical and mixed-earnings read; MP +9.07% and ALB +5.93% on a dividend declaration; UPS +5.75% on 2.4x volume. Best 20d: XLE +10.84%, XLU +7.91% — both today's worst, a mean-reversion watch. Watch tomorrow: SOXX — +3.91% but 20d -9.94%, momentum break vs 100p inflows, tactical reversal or dead-cat; META — -1.64% on 2.6x volume against QQQ +1.27%, mag-7 laggard; SHW -2.73% on 2.1x — housing cluster weakness (VNQ -0.84%) into Oct 29 GDP fc 3.2.
